items.question: Does Zoriva replace a doctor’s visit?
items.answer: No. Zoriva helps organize medications, reminders, and health history, but it does not diagnose conditions or replace professional medical advice.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Your data is encrypted, and you can further protect your account with a strong password and device-level controls.

items.question: Can I manage an account for my mom or dad?
items.answer: Yes. In family mode you can add loved ones’ profiles and support them remotely with reminders and dose tracking.

items.question: Does the app work on mobile?
items.answer: Yes. The interface is designed mobile-first, so it works comfortably on phones, tablets, and desktop devices.

items.question: When will medication price comparison be available?
items.answer: It is one of our planned premium features. Right now we are focused on refining the core experience around doses and family profiles.

items.question: Can I cancel at any time?
items.answer: Yes. There are no long-term commitments, and you can turn off Premium whenever you want.
